- **Source:** Pree posted it in #central-team themselves on 9 June 2026. The morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.
- **Status:** Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login. Nobody posted in the channel afterwards to say it was fixed, and I told Pree that.

I only looked at what Pree can see: #central-team and the Central team files. I didn't use message search.
